instructions: Sign in to Google Drive for Desktop in your browser using your Google Account ({{PRIMARY_EMAIL}}).
DO NOT select 'Desktop', 'Documents', or 'Pictures' if Google Drive's onboarding wizard prompts to back up or sync default Windows folders on this computer (leave all unchecked and skip).
DO configure Google Drive ('My Drive' syncing options) to 'Stream files' (NOT 'Mirror files') and confirm the virtual drive is mounted at {{STREAM_MOUNT}} ({{STREAM_VERIFY_FOLDER}}).
